interface.longDescription: Use independent graph and blitz orchestration skills from one installation. Graph selects and executes validated work graphs; Blitz forces overlapping work into isolated parallel slices, merges the results, and enforces a verification gate.
defaultPrompt: Use $eff:graph to orchestrate this as a validated work graph.
Use $eff:blitz to parallelize this work and merge it safely.
